title: Artificial Impressions: Evaluating Large Language Model Behavior Through the Lens of Trait Impressions

bias_targets.methodology: Applying linear probes trained on Stereotype Content Model dimensions (warmth and competence) to LLM hidden states to compare the artificial impressions formed when processing texts written in African American Language (AAL) versus White Mainstream English (WME).

Generating synthetic prompts conditioned on warmth and competence traits, training linear probes on LLM hidden representations, and correlating the predicted impressions with prompt linguistic features (using LIWC) and downstream model behaviors like response quality and hedging.
